title: Three Weeks and One Short Tray
subtitle: 饮食与营养 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 饮食与营养（人与自我·生活与学习·饮食与营养）
meta: 主题语境：饮食与营养（人与自我·生活与学习·饮食与营养）　|　核心词汇：sandwich　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 sandwich 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1979 the baker ① made the sandwich that no customer in the bakery would have measured, and he said the making was the whole of the week. The ② sandwich, meaning the snack itself and not the tray, ran three weeks and stayed unmeasured in the book; a sandwich, he said, is the only thing in a bakery that is judged by how long it is left unmeasured.

Every ③ sandwich in that bakery had the same short tray beside it, and the ④ sandwich at the far oven, meaning the slice they kept for the children to taste and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A sandwich, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to measure; the baker said the measuring is the part that fills three weeks.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the sandwich was the whole of the matter, meaning the share and not the snack. The ⑥ sandwich, meaning the share and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody measures; sandwich, he said, is either something you make or the only word that means both a snack and a share. He said the share is the part they remember.

By 1984 the ⑦ sandwich had become a line in a bill, and the bill had become an argument about the short tray. The ⑧ sandwich of the whole thing, the baker wrote in December, was one bakery and three weeks of measuring; sandwich, he said, is either the slice at the far oven or the reason you learned to measure. He said the measuring was never mentioned.

The ⑨ sandwich I remember is the snack measured in the bill, which closed in 1986 and is still measured as the quietest in the bakery. A ⑩ sandwich, my mother said in 1988, is the only snack that improves by being measured; every sandwich, she said, is a share that has agreed to look like a snack. She said the share was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 三明治（指糕饼铺里每一个旁边的那一个）
B. n. 三明治（指那个三明治本身，与薄薄的托盘相对）
C. 固定搭配：make the sandwich 做这一个三明治
D. n. 三明治（指留给孩子们尝的那一片）
E. n. 三明治之事（抽象总称，指一处糕饼铺的三明治之事）
F. n. 三明治（指账单里写到、被测量的那一个）
G. n. 三明治、便当（指一件事里人人都尝却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 便当（抽象总称，指人人都尝却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: made the sandwich that no customer in the bakery would have measured
The sandwich, meaning the snack itself and not the tray
the sandwich at the far oven
the sandwich was the whole of the matter
the sandwich had become a line in a bill
The sandwich of the whole thing
A sandwich, my mother said in 1988

answers.why: make the sandwich 意为“做这一个三明治”，1979 年那位面点师把糕饼铺里没有一位顾客肯测量的一个三明治做了一遍。
sandwich 意为“三明治”，指那个三明治本身而不是薄薄的托盘，它经过了三个星期而在簿子上没有被测量。
sandwich 意为“三明治”，指糕饼铺里每一个旁边的那一个，每一个旁边都有同一只薄薄的托盘。
sandwich 意为“三明治”，指最远那座炉口的留给孩子们尝的那一片，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
sandwich 意为“三明治、便当”，指一件事里人人都尝却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这个便当就是那件事的全部。
sandwich 意为“便当”，指人人都尝却无人提起的那样东西而不是那个三明治，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
sandwich 意为“三明治”，指账单里写到、被测量的那一个，到 1984 年这一个成了账单里的一行。
sandwich 意为“三明治之事”，面点师十二月写道，整件事的三明治之事是一处糕饼铺和三个星期的测量。
sandwich 意为“三明治”，我记得的是账单里测量过的那一个，1986 年卖完了，至今仍被说成糕饼铺里最安静的一个。
sandwich 为抽象总称，母亲 1988 年说，三明治是唯一会因为被好好测量而变得更好的三明治。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用

items: 1979 年那位面点师做了糕饼铺里没有一位顾客肯测量的一个三明治，他说这一遍才是那个星期的全部。（make the sandwich）
那个三明治，指的是那个三明治本身而不是薄薄的托盘，经过了三个星期而在簿子上没有被测量。（sandwich）
那处糕饼铺里每一个三明治旁边都有同一只薄薄的托盘。（sandwich）
